Gold and Silver Prices Decline to 5-Week Low

Gold and silver prices have fallen to a five-week low as of September 15, 2026. The latest rates for gold and silver were reported in major Indian cities including Delhi, Mumbai, and Kolkata. Specific prices for 24K, 22K, and 18K gold were made available.
